title: Hongjun Encounters Jinglong in Chang'an
overview: Sent to the mortal world, Hongjun must report to the Exorcism Department, find his father's killers, and retrieve the Heart Lamp. He fights a Flying Mastiff before arriving in the capital.

title: The Lieutenant's Reputation
overview: Hongjun shatters his divine shield upon meeting Captain Li Jinglong, accidentally merging a rare pendant into Li's body. Meanwhile, the Emperor plots to put Li in charge of exorcisms.

title: The Exorcist Residence
overview: Hongjun, Mo Rigen, Atai, and Yongsi meet at the department. Jinglong arrives angry but is knocked out by mistake. Once awake, he assumes command and starts a massive renovation.

title: Going Back the Brothel to Investigate
overview: The team buys the Wisdom Sword and investigates a missing cat. While staking out a brothel, they find fox fur and a dried corpse, while Lady Guo secretly drains palace maids.

title: The Wolf and the Moon
overview: Using music as bait, the team corners three hidden fox demons. Jinglong and Hongjun team up in a fierce street battle to slay the demon Jin Yun after city guards are wiped out.

title: The Exorcists Subdued the Demon in Seconds by Tricks
overview: The team tracks a lone demon to the palace. Later, an infatuated guard frees a captured fox demon, leading to a final ambush where the vengeful demon Fei Ao is cornered and killed.

title: The Court of Exorcism in Existential Crisis
overview: During a treacherous night battle at the imperial palace, the magical Shanhe Brush displays its immense, universe-shaping power as the entire Exorcism Department faces a deadly crisis.

title: Undercover Exorcists in the Imperial Examination
overview: Sinister demons infiltrate the Imperial Academy, causing dark currents to surge during the autumn exams. The Exorcism Department launches a high-stakes hunt across the grounds.

title: Misfortunes Never Come Singly
overview: Li Jinglong uncovers a massive, deep-rooted conspiracy orchestrated by the fox clan. Amid a lively celebration by the poetic railings, hidden dangers lurk just out of sight.

title: Someone's been killed! What's going on
overview: A wave of frequent, brutal murders plagues the city of Chang'an. Inner demons grow stronger as the entire family of Qin Wu is ruthlessly exterminated by dark forces.

title: The exorcist is trapped in visions
overview: Deep, hidden mysteries are uncovered within the mystical Sumeru Mustard Seed. The entire Exorcism Department falls victim to a terrifying and deceptive Blood Luo illusion.

title: Fox Demon Deceives the Crowd, Golden Roc Appeared
overview: A dangerous dragon offspring emerges from the shattered Blood Luo illusion to steal human souls. Simultaneously, the legendary Golden-Winged Roc appears over Chang'an.

title: Fighting with the fox queen
overview: The powerful Heart Lamp erupts, allowing the Chief Historian to slay a dragon. The Exorcism Department fights to protect the Emperor during a final showdown with the Fox King.
